core_rule: all and exactly three currently audit-valid 20 px closed-loop attempts per condition; no valid attempt omitted
double_fault_rule: all currently audit-valid 15 px closed-loop attempts included; protocol permits up to three per condition
invalid_and_aborted_attempts: retained outside formal membership and included by the non-selective all-attempt inventory
start_variant_amendment: latest on-site instruction uses standard-start repeats; no unproven +/-3 px labels are assigned
